verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਨ ਇਛਾ ਕਛੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਅਚੇਤ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: karat na ichhaa kachh mitr satrataa na jaanai baal budh sudh naeh baalak achet kau ||

en.bdb: Due to his childlike wisdom and unawareness of all sorts, a child is innocent, He desires nothing, nor does he harbour any hostility or friendship with anyone;

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਡੋਲੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਮੁਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਤ ਹੇਤ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: asan basan le'ee maataa paachhai laagee ddolai bolai mukh a(n)mirat bachan sut het kau ||

en.bdb: His mother out of love keeps wandering behind him with food and clothing and utters elixir-like loving words for her son;

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕੈ ਅਸੀਸ ਦੈਨਹਾਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਰਿ ਦੈਨਹਾਰੀ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਡਾਰੀ ਸੇਤ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: baalakai asees dhainahaaree at piaaree laagai gaar dhainahaaree balihaaree ddaaree set kau ||

en.bdb: The mother loves her friends who keep showering blessings on her son but one who abuses him or say ill words for him destroys her peace of mind and creates duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਅਨੰਦਮਈ ਜੈਸੇੋ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤੈਸੇੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਫਲੁ ਖੇਤ ਕਉ ॥੩੯੩॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh samadharasee ana(n)dhamiee jaiseo jag maanai taiseo laagai fal khet kau ||393||

en.bdb: Like an innocent child, the obedient Sikh maintains impartiality. The Sikh treats everyone equally and by virtue of relishing on Naam (as blessed by the Guru) stays in bliss. Whatever way a person is recognized by the world, they are blessed with that reward. (393)
